children: Societe Generale rates strategists raise their forecasts for 10-year German Bund yields, as the rise in long-end yields is not over, they say in a note. They expect the 10-year Bund yields to peak around 3.85% in the first quarter of 2027, they say. Near term, the U.S.-Iran conflict and energy remain the key drivers and the source of uncertainty for rates and market pricing of the European Central Bank's rate path, they say. "The speed of the recent ECB repricing has surprised many market participants, but the level of the terminal rate can easily be rationalized," they say. The 10-year Bund yield closed at 3.478% on Thursday, according to LSEG. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
